catalogCliHelp:
usage: cg_generate_help_catalog.py [-h] [--root ROOT] (--write | --check |
                                   --stdout |
                                   --preview-definition-digest QUALIFIED_ID |
                                   --repin-definition-digest QUALIFIED_ID)
                                   [--reviewed]

Generate or verify the deterministic command help catalog.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Canonical Compound GPID source root.
  --write               Atomically write the catalog.
  --check               Check catalog freshness.
  --stdout              Write expected catalog bytes to stdout.
  --preview-definition-digest QUALIFIED_ID
                        Preview one named record's current and computed
                        definition digest.
  --repin-definition-digest QUALIFIED_ID
                        Refresh one named record's digest after metadata
                        review.
  --reviewed            Confirm that the one record selected for repinning was
                        reviewed.
